heroLead: Kilby Butte Colony is a Hutterite colony in Musselshell County, and mineral ownership tied to colony land follows different rules than a typical family parcel.
intro: Most of what I know about colony-adjacent minerals I learned the hard way, sitting across from families who assumed a Hutterite colony's landholding worked like any other ranch. It usually doesn't. Colonies typically hold land communally through the colony corporation rather than as individual family tracts, which means a mineral interest connected to Kilby Butte Colony ground may trace to a corporate conveyance rather than a personal deed. If you're not part of the colony but hold a legacy interest that predates the colony's purchase of the surface, that's a different and more common situation — the mineral estate was often severed off before the colony ever acquired the land.

I've spent enough hours in the Musselshell County records room untangling this exact pattern to know it's worth doing carefully. A rushed title check on colony-adjacent ground is how a family ends up either overpaid on a claim it doesn't fully own, or walking away from real money because a buyer didn't want to do the work.

sections.heading: Pre-colony severances
paragraphs: When Hutterite colonies buy ranchland in Montana, they typically buy the surface. Minerals were frequently severed off generations earlier under the original homestead patent and passed down a completely separate family line that has nothing to do with the colony today. If that's your situation, I trace the mineral chain independently of who currently farms the surface.

sections.heading: What activity looks like in this part of the county
paragraphs: This corner of Musselshell County has seen some CBM leasing interest tied to the broader Bull Mountains trend, though activity immediately around Kilby Butte has been light. I check current lease status and any nearby permits before discussing value.

faqs.question: The colony owns the surface — do they also own the minerals?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Minerals are frequently severed under a separate, older chain of title that predates the colony's purchase. I verify this from the recorded deeds.

faqs.question: Is there current oil or gas activity near Kilby Butte Colony?
faqs.answer: Light, mostly tied to the broader Bull Mountains CBM trend. I confirm the status on your specific interest before making an offer.

faqs.question: How do I even know if my family still holds a mineral interest out there?
faqs.answer: Give me the family name and rough location and I'll pull the recorded chain from the Musselshell County Clerk and Recorder to check.

faqs.question: Does it matter that I'm not part of the colony myself?
faqs.answer: No. Legacy mineral interests near colony land commonly belong to families with no current connection to the colony, and I buy those directly from the rightful heir.
